user.title: Connect to Enki
user.description: Use the same email and password as the Enki mobile app (Leroy Merlin).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Enki
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials for {username} stopped working. Enter the Enki password again.

telemetry.title: Help extend Enki support
telemetry.description:
Optional opt-in: when a new or unsupported device is detected on your account, Home Assistant can notify you with a **pre-filled GitHub link** (anonymized profile: type, model, capabilities).

Nothing is sent automatically — you decide whether to open the link. This helps prioritize heaters, shutters, sockets, and other hardware.

You can change this anytime under **Enki → Configure**.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Enki cloud. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Verify your Enki app email and password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Enki account is already configured.

data.telemetry: Notify me about new or unsupported devices (anonymized; pre-filled GitHub link only — nothing sent without your click)

gateway_key_rejected.title: Enki gateway key rejected
gateway_key_rejected.description: The Enki API returned HTTP 403 for `{service}`: a gateway (micro-service) key is likely outdated after an Enki app update. Reads and commands on that service will keep failing until the key is refreshed. See the linked guide.

cloud_unreachable.title: Enki cloud unreachable
cloud_unreachable.description: Home Assistant can't reach the Enki cloud (network, timeout, or server error). Entities won't update until connectivity is restored. Check your internet connection and the Home Assistant logs.

maintenance.title: Enki maintenance in progress
maintenance.description: The Enki cloud reports maintenance in progress. Some features may be temporarily unavailable.

telemetry_nudge.title: Enki — help prioritize new device support
telemetry_nudge.description: Turn on opt-in telemetry under Enki → Configure to be notified when an unsupported Enki device is detected on your account. Only anonymized data (type, model, capabilities) is used — nothing is sent without a click. This helps prioritize support for heaters, shutters, sockets, and other hardware.

new_device_profile.title: Enki — new device profile
new_device_profile.description: A new device profile was detected: {summary}. Anonymized data only — nothing is sent without your action. Use the Learn more link to open a pre-filled GitHub issue.

unsupported_device.title: Enki — unsupported device
unsupported_device.description: The device profile {summary} is not supported by the integration yet. Use the Learn more link to request support on GitHub.
